title: Ever been in a mall that was on an airplane?
content: I dreamt I was in this huge super jumbo jet flying long distance. Everything seemed normal at first, except I asked the guy next to me where he was from and he ignored me. Eventually I get up and start to explore the plane. As I explore I start finding stores, restaurants & bars. They were all small and dark, but busy. One store in particular had beaded curtains for an entrance. The entire dream, everyone on the plane acted like I was invisible & would ignore me. I even grabbed a drink from the bar and no one noticed me. The drink came in a toothpaste tube, which I thought was bizarre. The whole dream was extremely vivid. I was super pissed that I got woke up by my alarm before I was finished exploring.
